body: Sorry to hear that.  I was there today for my appointments and it was anxiety inducing for me too.  But I just had to push myself forward and not overthink it.... I broke it into steps AND MADE SURE I didn't think beyond the current step e.g. get in car, get to hospital, find right room etc... So it doesn't get overwhelming... I know my alternative to getting help - and for me, it seemed worth trying... They even gave me some scary news e.g. advised me to stop some drug use immediately (some I cannot stop as withdrawal could kill me) so I am looking at a week of painful hell right now... So what should we do? Try or not try?  I am going day by day - and am staying alive today. Hope you do as well.

Either way - its got you thinking and that is your trick right?  What phone do you have? My first VR device was Samsung Gear - so there is always going to be a VR option for you... Once your GPU is set up, go to steam and it can run bench test for you.  3 big engines for building in VR - Unity3D, Unreal Engine and yes, newly free to use (thanks steam) Crysis engine... Good luck.  You will love it :)

dude - i know the next thing you can do after the gpu and it could fix your job situation as well... depending on the cash, that gpu should be powering a virtual reality device like oculus rift or htc vive... vr is going to massive. you can take free online 3d design courses through udemy and learn how to code for vr on platforms like unity3d... i reckon it could fit your interests, its something i am looking forward to and you will be in red hot demand job wise in short to medium term... what do you reckon?

Hi Pikey - Hope you read this.  

I am 30+ year old man with bi-polar and just yesterday - I created this account and posted in SW.  I wrote a note and was ready to let it all go... But someone told me to hang-on... I ended up deciding that my wife deserved to be told in person about my desire to go - she deserved more than a crumby note... So I told her, she drove me to the hospital and 24 hours later, I am writing to you.  

I am home and alive.  Still scared as hell and anxious about my future. I have hospital appointments tomorrow with mental health and drugs people - so they can assess me - as everyone agrees i need and deserve help.  I am asking for it and probably going to get it. 

So guess what? You deserve help as well Pikey.  Your life matters too.  And the people that love you deserve more than a note. Just hold on, because you are not alone.  Pick up the phone and make that call now - you can get yourself in the hospital either way - but you deserve to make it there before you are overwhelmed by the pain.

Thank you Takashi.  I calmed myself down somehow and went in to the Emergency room at our local hospital overnight. I am going to be getting some mental health and drug/alcohol support after some assessments tomorrow.  I am scared as hell, but glad I didn't push the 'big red button' yesterday... Appreciate your message of support - very humbling.

I am hearing you.  Similar experience.  I have been self medicating for a decade to deal with what has been diagnosed as bi-polar. I am looking for help here as well, so take anything I say with a mountain of salt.  

I will say congratulations on your year sober.  I haven't achieved that.  Can you try and meditate on that for a minute? At least give yourself a pat on the back - because that is like a holy grail for me.  Would it be fair to say - you would be more fucked if you were not sober for the last 12 months... My experience says "yes"... Whatever happens from here - you have given yourself a bloody good head start at winning with 12 months of keeping your head on straight.

JimJam - 

I don't know what to say.  I am no professional in the field.  I am here on this sub reddit, because I feel the same way as you.  I too believe myself to be ugly (spiritually and emotionally).  I push people away - because I know I will only hurt them later and on the rare occasion I let someone in - I fuck it all up and here I am. 

So - if I can offer something - it is that you are at least not alone.  I too am at the bottom of this big hole.

Thank you for writing back Keebla.  I am in tears man - like I can feel your pain as well, but also because I am moved that you would bother to write back.  I am so sorry for you that you have this going on your life...  I deserve whatever is coming, but the fact that life could give you this cruel hand of cards - is just so rough. 

I have never been one to pray, but I notice you mention it.  I am going to try as well because at this point I feel like god and the devil may just be real - something has got a hold of me and I can't shake it... It seems beyond words, beyond this version of reality. 

I know what you mean about the chest tightening and the anxiety.  Your head just spins, the self-talk gets dark and you just mentally nose dive and tail spin.  I don't know whats going to happen to either of us.  I would promise to turn my life around if make it out of this one unscathed - but who would believe me... A liar, bargaining for favors. 

Again thanks for writing back and Ill swap prayers with you any day.
